name: agent-tree
description: Terminal side pane that shows your agents as a live tree, across all open terminals: what each one does, how full its context is, what it costs, which file two of them change. Tabs open reports, files, log, cost and terminals. Stop or redirect an agent, switch its model and effort, and hand simple tasks to a local model to save tokens.

columns.title: Width
columns.description: Columns of the docked pane; a width dragged by hand wins

maxAgents.title: Agents kept
maxAgents.description: How many sub-agents the tree keeps; the oldest finished ones go first

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

animate.title: Motion
animate.description: Draw the spinner, the flow while agents work and the start intro

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in German or English; auto follows the language setting

intro.title: Start intro
intro.description: The Agent Tree logo builds up in the pane when a session starts; click or type to skip

tips.title: Tips
tips.description: Show one tip per session in the pane's bottom line instead of the key list

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update
autoUpdate.description: Once a day, install a newer Agent Tree from its marketplace

localModel.title: Local model
localModel.description: Name of a model on your own server (for example qwen2.5-coder:7b in Ollama); Claude Code can then hand it simple tasks. Empty turns it off

localUrl.title: Local model address
localUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible address of that server: Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
